content:
Email template — Payslip

Email templates allow you to standardize communications when sending payslips to employees. This ensures consistent, professional messaging while saving time through automation.

The email template will be used whenever you email a payslip directly from the software. You can customize both the subject line and message body to match your organization's communication style.

Using Placeholders

Placeholders automatically insert specific information into your emails. When the email is sent, placeholders are replaced with actual data from the payslip and employee records.

Common placeholders include employee names, pay periods, and payment amounts. The available placeholders are shown when editing the template, making it easy to create personalized messages.

Best Practices

Keep your subject line clear and descriptive so employees can easily identify payslip emails in their inbox. Include key information like the pay period or payment date.

In the message body, provide essential details while keeping the tone professional yet friendly. Consider including information about where employees can direct questions about their pay.

Subject

Default email subject line when emailing payslips.

Message body

Default email body text when emailing payslips. You can include merge fields to personalize the message.
